name: EPA Greenhouse Gas Inventory and GHGRP Coverage Boundary
known_limitations: The national inventory and facility-level reporting program use different scopes and methods. Neither alone proves causation, compliance, emissions reduction, or a complete local emissions balance.
automation_notes: Keep reporting-year, threshold, sector, facility, national-inventory, and revision boundaries attached to downstream claims.
notes: EPA explains why its national inventory and Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program are complementary rather than interchangeable.
